# PIXELOG

> PIXELOG (Pixelog Digital and IT Solutions) is a digital marketing and IT solutions agency based in Thoothukudi (Tuticorin), Tamil Nadu, India. We help local businesses and brands grow with branding, social media marketing, influencer marketing, Meta Ads, video production, website development and SEO.
